name: evidence-seed
description: Seed benchmark for wiring validation and adversarial regression. Each job pairs genuinely strong evidence against transferable, participation-only and keyword-stuffed resumes, so a system that counts terms ranks differently from one that weighs evidence. This is NOT the 50-job, 200-500-pair expert-labelled benchmark the specification calls for before launch claims; labels here are authored from the spec's own adversarial cases rather than by independent reviewers. v1.1 adds a specificity job: two resumes identical in seniority, domain and phrasing that differ only in trial phase, so a system that cannot tell Phase I from Phase III is measurably penalised.
